chrome.privacy: This page does not store who you are.

start.title: Your search on {forum} was stopped.
start.body: Behind every image is a real child who was abused. Searching or watching makes that harm bigger.
start.question: What fits you best?
start.worried: I am worried about what I think or watch
start.direct: Want to talk to someone right away?

mistake.title: Okay. Thanks for reading this.
mistake.body: Word filters sometimes block a search by accident. You do not need to do anything else.
mistake.nudge: Did this make you think anyway? Help is anonymous.

worried.title: It is good that you stopped here.
worried.body: You are not the only one with these worries. Thoughts and habits like these can change.
worried.help: Help exists. It is anonymous and free.

consequences.title: What does the law say?
consequences.body: Viewing sexual images of children is a crime. Online too.
consequences.source: Articles {articles}, Dutch Criminal Code. In force since {since}.
consequences.help: Want to stop? There is anonymous help for that.

help.title: Talk to the {helpline}
help.subtitle: By {org}. Free and anonymous. Conversations are in Dutch.
help.anonymousBody: You do not have to say who you are.
anonymousPoints: They cannot see your phone number, and the call does not appear on your bill.
This page does not get your name or forum account.
help.reportedBody: What you share stays between you and the {helpline}. They do not pass it on to the police or the courts.
help.reportedException: Only if a child faces serious danger in the future do they have to report it.
expectSteps: Someone from the {helpline} answers. All staff are bound by professional secrecy.
You do not give your name. You decide what you share.
You talk about what is going on and what might help.
You can always hang up or close the chat.
help.selfHelpBody: An anonymous self-help programme, in Dutch. You work through it alone, at your own pace.
help.alsoFor: The {helpline} also helps partners, family and professionals.

later.title: Come back whenever you want
later.body: Save this link. The link and the title look neutral in your history or bookmarks.
later.note: The link contains nothing about you or your search.
